item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-d4a25b4ff6d5e5cd","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In his 22 June 2023 government statement, Scholz said Germany had adopted its first National Security Strategy, committed to long-term support for Ukraine, increased protection of NATO territory, and a more geopolitically capable Europe.","question_ids":["1B.1","2B.1","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly describes Scholz's stated 2023 program; implementation evidence is limited in this speech.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented these as decisions and priorities of his federal government.","limitations":["The source is a government statement and does not independently verify implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4a25b4ff6d5e5cd","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported that Germany had provided €16.8 billion in civilian and military aid to Ukraine since the beginning of the war, including a recent €2.7 billion package focused on armored vehicles, air defense, artillery, and ammunition.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The amounts and package were reported in June 2023 and concern the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the aid decisions to the German government.","limitations":["The speech does not provide independent expenditure records or assess civilian-harm monitoring."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4a25b4ff6d5e5cd","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany and its partners were supporting Ukraine while maintaining that the war must not escalate into a Russia-NATO confrontation; he also said Germany sought long-term security guarantees and economic resilience for Ukraine.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.8","2B.7","2B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly reflects the government's stated crisis-management position in June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz stated and defended this policy as Chancellor.","limitations":["This is rhetoric and diplomatic positioning, not an independent assessment of escalation risk."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4a25b4ff6d5e5cd","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany supported G7 de-risking from China through diversification rather than decoupling, including incentives for strategic stocks of critical raw materials and broader supplier and market relationships.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Policy position stated for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described the line agreed by Germany and its G7 partners and advocated its implementation.","limitations":["The source does not establish executed funding, measurable diversification, or distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d4a25b4ff6d5e5cd","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz supported the EU asylum-system compromise, combining registration at first-entry states, solidarity mechanisms, faster decisions at external borders, and financial contributions from states declining refugee relocation.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","6B.2","6B.3","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The compromise and Scholz's stated position were current in June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz said he would defend the compromise at the European Council and seek further agreement with Parliament.","limitations":["The source does not show final enactment, enforcement, or effects on asylum seekers."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4245351d77da7cf","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany had provided more than €14 billion in humanitarian, economic, and military assistance to Ukraine during the preceding twelve months, with weapons coordinated with allies, and had trained more than 3,000 Ukrainian soldiers, with over 1,000 additional trainees planned.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reported on 2 March 2023 for the preceding year and immediate 2023 plans.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the assistance and training to the federal government and Bundeswehr.","limitations":["The source does not independently assess proportionality, end-use controls, or battlefield outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4245351d77da7cf","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz stated that the government made weapons decisions cautiously and sought to ensure NATO did not become a party to the war while continuing support for Ukraine.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statement made in March 2023 during the Ukraine crisis.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz expressly described the decision rule of his government.","limitations":["The source provides no independent review of the decisions or their consequences."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4245351d77da7cf","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported that the government had established a €100 billion Bundeswehr special fund, initiated major procurement including F-35 aircraft, committed to NATO's two-percent target, and designated forces for Lithuania and NATO readiness.","question_ids":["2B.8","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports measures in force or initiated by March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented these as actions of his government and parliamentary majority.","limitations":["The speech does not assess procurement performance, cost control, or security outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4245351d77da7cf","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany had diversified energy supplies after Russia halted deliveries, filled gas storage to more than 70 percent, commissioned new LNG terminals and pipelines, and avoided the feared winter supply crisis.","question_ids":["5B.9","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported in March 2023 concerning the 2022–23 winter and immediate policy response.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the response to federal and state action and infrastructure investment.","limitations":["The speech is self-reported and does not quantify costs, emissions, or distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b4245351d77da7cf","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said laws had removed barriers to renewable expansion, set a target of 80 percent renewable electricity by 2030, and aimed to triple onshore, offshore, and rooftop expansion.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Program and enacted-law claims made in March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the laws and targets to his government and the federal legislative process.","limitations":["The source does not establish 2023 completion against the target."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fb4261c0d782d92b","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"After the Hamas attack on Israel, Scholz traveled to Israel and Egypt and said he used meetings with regional leaders to prevent regional escalation, block entry by Hezbollah, Iran, or proxies, secure hostage release, and enable humanitarian aid to Gaza.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.5","2B.7","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the October 2023 crisis.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described his own diplomatic actions and Germany's position.","limitations":["The source does not establish the effectiveness or humanitarian adequacy of the resulting measures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fb4261c0d782d92b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said Germany would provide Ukraine with a winter support package including an additional Patriot unit, IRIS-T and Gepard systems, ammunition, and financial support, while advocating European budget assistance and reprioritization.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.8","8B.3","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Policy commitments stated in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented these as commitments of the German government and its European partners.","limitations":["The speech does not document subsequent delivery or effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fb4261c0d782d92b","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the EU interior ministers had reached a common agreement on asylum-system reform after years of deadlock, including first-entry registration, solidarity mechanisms, improved Dublin returns, rapid border decisions, and expanded German border policing with neighboring states.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The agreement and German measures were reported in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz claimed credit for the government's role and committed to advancing implementation.","limitations":["The source does not independently evaluate rights compliance, final legislative adoption, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f8b3c86a00ac1d77","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the government had changed laws and targets to accelerate renewable expansion, had reached approximately 30 football fields of daily solar installation, recorded about 200 wind-permit approvals in June, and was planning a nationwide electricity and hydrogen network.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Claims made in October 2023 about contemporaneous implementation and planned infrastructure.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the changes and projects to his government and cooperation with the Länder.","limitations":["The figures are presented without independent methodology or evidence of completed construction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f8b3c86a00ac1d77","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported that Germany had maintained gas supply through Norwegian and western-European imports, expanded pipelines and LNG terminals, and sought to protect energy-intensive firms with price compensation and EU-compliant measures.","question_ids":["5B.9","5B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Statement made in October 2023 concerning the 2022–23 energy shock and ongoing policy.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the response to federal action and cooperation with industry and unions.","limitations":["No independent cost, targeting, or firm-survival evaluation is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-f8b3c86a00ac1d77","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the government had enacted a skilled-immigration law, planned modernized citizenship rules, expanded worker protections, and maintained asylum protection for people fleeing persecution, war, and terror while supporting returns for rejected applicants.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","5B.4","6B.3","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Policy statements made in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz described legislative and administrative priorities of his government.","limitations":["The source does not provide implementation or equal-access outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0eede780ca112ac","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, Scholz proposed a cross-government 'Deutschlandpakt' with the Länder, municipalities, opposition, businesses, and unions to accelerate energy, housing, infrastructure, digital administration, and permitting; he cited 85 percent federal online-service implementation, versus one quarter at Länder and municipal level.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 budget speech and contemporaneous administrative performance.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz proposed the pact and reported the implementation percentages.","limitations":["The pact was presented as an offer; the source does not show completion or independent verification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0eede780ca112ac","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz said the government planned €24 billion of additional rail investment over four years, €18 billion for subsidized housing, €58 billion in 2024 climate-transformation investment, and €54 billion in federal investment in rail, bridges, internet, and charging infrastructure.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.2","6B.3","8B.2","8B.3"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Budget proposals and allocations described in September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the programs to the federal budget and climate-transformation fund.","limitations":["The source does not establish executed spending or project quality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0eede780ca112ac","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported that more than €80 billion in international investment had been committed to German future industries, including biotechnology, batteries, clean technology, climate-neutral steel, and AI, and cited Intel's planned €30 billion Magdeburg investment.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported in September 2023 as contemporaneous investment outcomes or commitments.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz presented these as evidence associated with federal economic policy.","limitations":["The source does not establish causation, subsidy cost, or realized employment outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a0eede780ca112ac","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"Scholz reported social-relief measures including inflation adjustment for 48 million taxpayers, tax-free one-time payments, higher pensions, increased child benefit and child supplement, and planned child basic security; he said purchasing power had begun rising again.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Measures and claimed early effects reported in September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Scholz attributed the measures to the federal government.","limitations":["The source does not independently verify incidence or whether gains were durable."]},{"source_id":"SRC-647202b3b5259e23","start_unit":18,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The Bundestag passed the Pflegeunterstützungs- und -entlastungsgesetz on 26 May 2023, establishing improvements for people needing care and relatives, stabilizing long-term-care insurance finances, improving working conditions, and strengthening digitalization.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.4","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Enacted during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The law was enacted by the federal legislative process under Scholz's coalition government.","limitations":["The source is a ministry summary and does not independently evaluate outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-647202b3b5259e23","start_unit":19,"end_unit":23,"fact_summary":"The PUEG scheduled a 5 percent increase in home-care benefits from January 2024, a further 4.5 percent increase in all benefits from January 2025, higher inpatient-care supplements, and a 0.35-percentage-point contribution increase from July 2023 to raise approximately €6.6 billion annually.","question_ids":["5B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Legislation enacted in 2023 with effects scheduled for 2023–2025.","ruler_attribution":"The ministry described these as statutory provisions of the PUEG.","limitations":["Most benefit increases were future-dated; the source does not assess net distributional effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-647202b3b5259e23","start_unit":24,"end_unit":26,"fact_summary":"The PUEG extended care-worker work-family funding through 2030, financed staffing pools, limited recognition of excessive agency-work costs, supported qualification of care assistants and foreign workers, extended digitalization funding, and gave municipalities a permanent initiative right for care-support centers.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statutory measures enacted in May 2023, with implementation extending beyond the target year.","ruler_attribution":"The federal law created these funding, staffing, digitalization, and municipal mechanisms.","limitations":["The source does not show actual uptake, staffing gains, or service-quality effects in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b7e38f54c1f47fb6","start_unit":24,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The governing coalition introduced a bill in September 2023 to relax evidentiary requirements for ethnic-German repatriate applications after court-driven administrative practice had increased rejections and threatened to reduce admissions.","question_ids":["4B.7","6B.3","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The bill was introduced and debated in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The bill was sponsored by SPD, Greens, and FDP coalition factions.","limitations":["The source describes the legislative rationale, not final effects at the individual level."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b7e38f54c1f47fb6","start_unit":32,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"On 16 November 2023, the Bundestag approved the coalition's amendment to the Federal Expellees Act by a broad majority; it enabled return toward the earlier administrative practice and authorized preservation and disclosure of relevant status records, while rejecting the AfD alternative.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.7","6B.3","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct legislative action in November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The law was passed by the coalition parliamentary majority under Scholz's government.","limitations":["The source does not document administrative implementation or effects on admissions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-89d4051f40d48eb9","start_unit":24,"end_unit":25,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, Bundestag debate over a proposed Cum-Ex investigative committee recorded allegations that Hamburg had failed to reclaim €280 million in improperly refunded capital-gains tax and that Scholz's recollection of meetings with Warburg Bank's owner changed between inquiries; coalition representatives disputed the allegations and cited Hamburg's existing investigation.","question_ids":["4B.4","7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source records 2023 parliamentary allegations and counterclaims about earlier conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations concern Scholz's prior role as Hamburg mayor; the source does not establish their truth.","limitations":["This is a parliamentary account of contested allegations, not a final finding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-89d4051f40d48eb9","start_unit":31,"end_unit":33,"fact_summary":"At a June 2023 hearing, most legal experts criticized the proposed federal Cum-Ex committee as constitutionally overbroad, while other experts considered it permissible if focused on federal oversight and tax administration.","question_ids":["4B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Institutional finding during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Bundestag's proposed inquiry into matters involving Scholz; it is not a finding of Scholz's personal misconduct.","limitations":["Expert views were divided and the source does not provide a judicial ruling."]},{"source_id":"SRC-89d4051f40d48eb9","start_unit":34,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"On 5 July 2023, the Bundestag rejected the proposed Cum-Ex investigative committee despite the opposition having the required quorum; coalition factions supported rejection, while the Bundestag adopted a separate request that authorities preserve relevant Cum-Ex records.","question_ids":["4B.4","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct parliamentary action in July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The rejection was carried by Scholz's coalition parliamentary majority; Scholz's personal role in the vote is not specified.","limitations":["The source records competing constitutional arguments and does not establish obstruction for personal benefit."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-42cffb3c813f0a12","SRC-905f80bbd0b4fb9f","SRC-e7f0be6ebd9779fa","SRC-1f71d2eb97ca7059"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied Munich Security Conference document is explicitly dated February 2026 and therefore falls outside the 2023–2023 period.","The Bundesbank statement is an institutional 2023 financial report delivered in 2024 and does not attribute a concrete decision or outcome to Scholz.","The G7/G20 page is an index of documents rather than a substantive source containing a concrete Scholz-related fact.","SRC-1f71d2eb97ca7059 duplicates the Cum-Ex material covered by SRC-89d4051f40d48eb9; no additional distinct fact was emitted."]}
